completion_decisions: Use analytic circle overlap as the deterministic partial-wake completion.
Use the paper/cited-lineage population and registered mid-range GA controls.
Use counter-based random events and ordered commits for worker-count-independent scientific results.
missing_information: exact crossover and mutation choices inside reported ranges

paper.authors: G. Mosetti and C. Poloni and B. Diviacco
paper.title: Optimization of Wind Turbine Positioning in Large Windfarms by Means of a Genetic Algorithm
paper.venue: Journal of Wind Engineering and Industrial Aerodynamics

paper_source_conflicts: No author implementation was located; a later no-license repository was used only as a digitized-wind cross-check.
The paper does not fully specify partial-wake geometry or every GA control.

scope.claim_boundary: paper-equation academic declared reproduction; no author-source or author-exact numerical claim

constraints_and_repair.resolution: one turbine at most per grid cell; empty layouts repair to one deterministic cell

decision_variables.resolution: 100 binary occupancy variables on a 10 by 10 grid

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: two-word packed binary layout; row-major cell-center decoder

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: objective, power, turbine count, physical FES, stage timings, and scientific hash

objective_and_direction.resolution: minimize farm cost divided by expected farm power

paper_native_cases.resolution: Mosetti Cases A, B, and C registered as switchable problems

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 200 initial evaluations plus 400 populations of 200 equals 80200 physical FES

update_order.resolution: roulette selection, uniform crossover, bit mutation, elitist ordered commit

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Jensen wake, analytic rotor overlap, root-sum-square deficits, registered power and cost curves

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: paper Cases A, B, and normalized C joint direction-speed weights
